_readme: Prizes we've actually been awarded that aren't leaderboard-based —
Golden Tickets, Greatest Two Minutes in Giving, Discover the Good, and so on.
These live here rather than being fetched, because the event's winner tables
sit behind a login. Add an entry when a win is announced on
wins    — confirmed, a fixed dollar amount actually paid out. Shown at the
top of the panel, largest first, summed into the headline total.
pending — real but not yet confirmed: no winner table, no fixed amount, just
a rule (e.g. "up to 10% of what we raised"). Shown separately below
a divider and never counted into the confirmed total. Give it either
estimatePct (computed live as that % of the current raised total,
shown as "Up to $X") or amount if a fixed figure gets confirmed —
at that point move it into wins instead.
Edit straight from a phone: open the repo, tap wins.json, tap the pencil.
amount is in whole dollars. note and sponsor are optional.
Delete nothing else; the page reads only the wins and pending arrays.

wins.note: Tier 1, most donations: 956 vs 937 for 2nd place

pending.note: A $55,250 pool split proportionately among eligible Tier 1 organizations (annual revenue under $50,000), capped at 10% of what each org raised. 10% of our total is the most we could personally receive — the actual amount is set by the sponsors, not shown on any leaderboard, and depends on how many other orgs qualify.
pending.sponsor: Sam Swope family, Jewish Heritage Fund, LG&E and KU Foundation, Brown-Forman, Delta Dental of Kentucky
